scope: Offline aggregate power observability and exact data integrity only. All hardware identifiers excluded from numerical statistics. No emitter classification, fingerprints, classifier fit, or real-device identity conclusions. No signal demodulation, no MAC/BSSID processing. Pooled cohort results not per-device descriptors. Date/environment confounded.

method.window: Rectangular nonoverlapping complete FFT blocks; no padding, compute averaged bin power from all complete finite blocks. Sum coarse bins, verify integrated discrete power conservation; project coarse distribution uniformly onto constituent fine bins and measure total variation vs fine normalized distribution. This is loss relative to a fixed discrete representation, not recovered signal identity.
method.temporal: Report recorded durations and available block counts; compare actual span to telescope integration interval; do not concatenate unrelated recordings or synthesize missing coverage.
method.checks: Reauthenticate exact R37E1 metadata-inventory artifact, all archive bytes/checksums and every paired meta hash, hash actual sample bytes, reject duplicates across dates and within date, sample size and datatype, finite power, power conservation. Do not deserialize MAT/NPZ or raw executable content.
method.cohorts: Report only count, median/p10/p90 for pooled entire-date summaries (not labels). Same separate days as R37E1; no examination of identity and no threshold fit.

telescope_reference.rule: If actual instantaneous observation duration or attainable frequency resolution cannot support target, mark INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVATION; no claim of matched telescope resolution. Finite record duration limits resolvable frequency even if zero padding.

gate: Integrity and aggregate observability measurements may PASS separately. Physical source discrimination, change-of-receiver transfer, calibrated identification abstention and R38 remain HOLD without independent labels, payload controls and comparable measured astronomy spectra. No G4 or production changes.
